profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company traded under the ticker STX, headquartered in Singapore, with its website at seagate.com. On its own site the company describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. It says it makes storage that scales and that it brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site frames AI as a driver of data growth, saying that people and machines will create in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates, producing massive volumes of data. Seagate says it is optimizing storage for AI and making gains in capacity to support efficient data center architecture and buildout, and it points to five strategic shifts it says can help close the gap between AI's data demands and infrastructure readiness.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
